title: Timeless Mini
blurb: A tiny arena where the clock is your health. Get hit, lose seconds. Win fights, win time back.

title: Orbit Sling
blurb: Circle a planet, tap to let go, and fling yourself to the next one. Real gravity, one thumb.

title: Daily Grid
blurb: One new lights puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Turn every tile off in as few taps as you can.
